gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.0: The Eye blinks. He's just hungry, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.1: He's looking at your pocket. There was a nibble in there once.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.2: Sauceron is purring. He really is. Softly.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.3: One little piece of ring and he was happy. He could have just said so.
gui.guhs.ringh5.beeldje.4: The Eye sees everything. Except rocks. And the dishes.
quest.guhs.ringh5.oog.gezien: The Eye is looking at you! Out of the light, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh5.oog.ring: The Eye can feel the ring... Take it off, quick!
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.gezien: Hey! You there! Stay right where you are, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.snuif.0: *sniff sniff* Do you smell nibble too? I smell nibble. I don't see any nibble.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.snuif.1: Who said "nyeg" just now? ... Nobody. I'm getting old.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.snuif.2: There's a draft in here. A draft with a ring on. Oh well, never mind.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.weg: Off you go! This fence is staff only. And for anyone we can't see.
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.na.0: Walk right on through, Ring-Bearer. Thanks for the snack, wahoog!
quest.guhs.ringh5.wachter.na.1: The boss is finally asleep. We're on break all day long. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.hallo: Ah, the ring-bearer. Come sit by the fire. I'll keep watch. And keep an eye on the ring.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.spijt.0: Don't look at me like that. I'm already ashamed enough for three Mikas.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.spijt.1: I'll stay here on watch. Far away from that ring. It's better this way, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.spijt.2: Don't trust that skinny one too much. He looks at the ring the way I looked at the ring.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.na.0: Fried and shared! And I got a piece too. I didn't deserve that. It was tasty, though.
quest.guhs.ringh5.boromika.na.1: I'm still keeping watch. There's nothing left to guard, but I've gotten good at it.
quest.guhs.ringh5.geritsel: Something is rustling by the provisions. Somebody's into the nibbles!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.betrapt: No whacking! No whacking! We don't steal, we... only taste. It smelled like our chonkie, nyeg. Sweet guh carries the chonkie, yes? We know a way past the Eye. A sneak path. We shows it!
gui.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.ja: All right. Show us the way.
gui.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.nee: Keep your paws off the provisions!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.zweer: We swears it! On the chonkie! Smikagol shows the way. Round the back, through the Little Grill Door. Follow us, chonkie... er, master.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.toe_nou: Oh please, oh please. Without Smikagol the Eye looks you right back home. Just click on us if you change your mind, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.sam.vertrouw_niet: I don't trust him one nibble. But a way is a way. I'm keeping my frying pan within paw's reach.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.3: Up the stairs, over the ridge. At the top master sees where we must go. Don't be scared.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.4: The Ash Field. See the light on the ground? That's where he looks. Run from little wall to little wall once it has passed. We waits at every wall.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.5: Bare, bare, everything bare. No more little walls. But master has the little cloak! Crouch and stand still when the light comes. Still as a stone.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.6: Shadow Lane. The Eye doesn't look here. First the smoke: let the phial flash and it blows away. Then the riders: flash them blind, or be a rock until they have passed.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.7: Grill Guards. Mikas! They can't see a ring... shh. At the skull post, chonkie on, through the fence, and right off again. Not on sooner, or the riders smell it. Not on longer, or the Eye has you.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.8: There, there! The Little Grill Door. Walk on, master. We picks the lock open. We are good with little locks.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.stap.9: Open! Open! Run, master, down the tunnel, before the white one is done with his fireworks!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.klaar: Past the Eye, past the Nine, past the guards. Well done, master. Now only the mountain is left. We knows a stair... a very, very long stair. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.0: And now straight on, master, out of the vale at the back. Follow your little nose: it smells like the fryer there. Nice and greasy. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.1: Not straight on, master, the vale is shut tight with rock there. The little tunnel close by, through the rock wall at the little lantern. That's where it smells like the fryer!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.2: Not straight on, master, there is rock there. Under the tower of the Eye, shh, on tippy-toesss... and on the other side the little tunnel through the rock wall. That's where it smells like the fryer!
quest.guhs.ringh5.smikagol.verder.dicht: Shh, master... at the back the vale is shut tight with rock, everywhere. Dig, then: straight through the back wall, outside the vale that is allowed. Or simply go back through the vale and around the outside: the guards and the Eye don't look at us anymore, we are past them already. Follow your little nose to the fryer. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ringh5.sam.klaar: Two stews for the climb. And I'm walking behind that creep, so I can see what he's up to.
quest.guhs.ringh5.rook.dicht: You can't see your own paw in this smoke. Didn't you have something that gives light?
quest.guhs.ringh5.rook.weg: The Light Phial flashes and the smoke blows away. Wahoog, the lane is clear!
quest.guhs.ringh5.poortje.dicht: The Little Grill Door is locked. Knocking won't help, nyeg.
gui.guhs.ringh5.doel.0: The camp before the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.ringh5.doel.7: The fire by the Little Grill Door
gui.guhs.ringh5.doel.ingang: The entrance to the vale of the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.uitleg: The gate to the land of Sauceron is shut tight, and from his tower the Eye is watching. Smikagol knows a sneak path. So he says. If you get spotted, you're right back at the last rest fire: you never lose anything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.0: Walk to the camp at the edge of Ash Vale. Your Super Compass and Sam-guh show the way.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.0: The camp before the Black Grill Gate, in the Ash Vale of the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.1: Talk to Boromika by the campfire. He does look at your ring for an awfully long time.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.1: The camp before the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.2: Something is rustling by the sacks of provisions. Go have a look and click on the thief.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.2: Behind the rock by the camp
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.3: Follow Smikagol up the stairs, over the ridge. At the top you'll see where to go.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.3: The stairs over the ridge behind the camp
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.4: Sneak across the Ash Field. Stay out of the light of the Eye: hide behind a little wall or under a little roof until it has passed.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.4: The Ash Field: diagonally to the left, to the Slag Hut by the rock wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.5: There's nothing to hide behind here. Is the light coming? Crouch and stand still with the Little Elven Cloak on you: then you're a rock.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.5: The Bare Plain: to the right, to the Hollow in the rock wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.6: Blow the smoke away with the Light Phial and slip past the two riders of the Nine. A flash blinds them, and a rock they can't see.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.6: The lane below the wall, up to the skull post
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.7: Three Grill Guards. Put the Nibble Ring on at the skull post, walk through the fence and take it right off again. No dawdling: the Eye can feel the ring!
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.7: The Guard Fence: to the fire by the Little Grill Door
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.8: Walk to the little door in the wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.waar.8: The Little Grill Door, on the left in the wall
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.9: The little door is open! Run down the tunnel to the fire behind the wall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.nu.klaar: You sneaked past the Eye. Wahoog! Now only Mount Fry is left.
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.0: To the camp by the Black Grill Gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.1: Talk to Boromika by the fire
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.2: See who's rustling in the provisions
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.4: Cross the Ash Field: stay out of the light
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.5: Cross the Bare Plain: crouch and be a rock
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.6: Blow the smoke away, past the riders
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.7: Ring on, through the Guard Fence, ring off
gui.guhs.verhalen.ring_h5.kort.9: Down the tunnel to the fire
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.0: The elven boats carried you to where the sauce river vanishes into the ash: Ash Vale.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.1: At the end of the vale stands a black wall with one gate. That gate is a grill, and it is shut.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.2: Above it, on his tower, stares the Eye of Sauceron. He's looking for his nibble. He has been hungry for a very, very long time.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.ring_h5.regel.3: Whoever he sees, he looks right back to the last fire. So: don't get seen, nyeg.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.begin: At the edge of Ash Vale a little fire is burning. Boromika is keeping watch. Mostly over your pocket.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.tonen: Show me that ring once more, little guh. It's so... round. And so crunchy.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.hapje: Just one little bite. Who would even notice? Give it to me, I'll keep it. Safe. In my tummy.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.foei: Down! Shame on you! Paws to yourself! Nyeg!
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.wat_deed_ik: What... what did I just do? My paw moved all by itself.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.vergeef: Forgive me. That was the ring, not me. Well. A tiny bit me.
scene.guhs.ringh5_boromika.wacht: I'll make it right. I'll stay here and keep watch, far away from that ring. Go, before I get hungry again.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.daar: There, master. At the end of the vale. The Black Grill Gate.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.dicht: Shutter than shut. A grill as tall as a house. And above it...
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.oog: The Eye of Sauceron. He has lost his nibble. He is hungry. He has been hungry for a very, very long time.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.licht: Does master see the light on the ground? That's where he looks. Stay out of the light. Behind little walls, under little roofs. Then he sees nothing.
scene.guhs.ringh5_oog.sluipweg: Smikagol knows a sneak path. Round the back, through the Little Grill Door. Follow us. Softly, softly...
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.titel: The Return of Guhdalf the White
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.op_slot: Locked! No, no, no... Wait, master. We picks it. We picks it very hard.
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.hoeven: Clattering hooves in the lane. The Nine have smelled the ring.
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.schiet_op: They're coming! Hurry up, you creep!
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.achteruit: Back, you skellies! I am Guhdalf the White. And I have only just eaten.
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.verblind: The light of his staff is brighter than a hundred Light Phials. The Nine can't see a paw in front of their snoots anymore.
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.vuurwerk: Hey, Sauceron! Over here! I brought fireworks!
scene.guhs.ringh5_guhdalf.ren: Run, little ring-bearer! The Eye is looking at me now. Through the little door. Nyeg!
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_gi: We Swears It on the Chonkie
Let Smikagol show you the way past the Black Grill Gate
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_ro: Blow the smoke of Shadow Lane away with the Light Phial
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_la: Walk past a Grill Guard with the ring on
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_h5_kl: Sneak past the Eye of Sauceron, the Nine and the Grill Guards
structure.guhs.zwarte_roosterpoort.toolt: The gate to the land of Sauceron, with the tower of the Eye behind it. Shut. Very, very shut (Guhbarbecuether)
